camel_example: aliyun dms ListMyAgenticNotificationChannelConfigs --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken MjA --Channel FEISHU --MaxResults 20 --version 2025-04-14 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the personal notification channel configurations of the current user in the current tenant, including channel status and bound identity information
description_zh: 查询当前用户在当前租户下的个人通知渠道配置，包括渠道开关和已绑定的身份信息
name: ListMyAgenticNotificationChannelConfigs

parameters.help_en: The notification channel type used to filter results. If you do not specify this parameter, all personal notification channels are returned. Currently, only FEISHU (Lark) is supported. Specifying other values results in a parameter error
parameters.help_zh: 通知渠道类型，用于筛选结果。不传时返回全部个人通知渠道。当前仅支持 FEISHU（飞书国内版），传入其他值会返回参数错误
parameters.name: channel

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 单页返回的最大记录数。取值范围为 1~100，默认值为 20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The paging token for the paged query. Do not specify this parameter for the first query. To query the next page, specify the NextToken value returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询的游标令牌。首次查询不传；查询下一页时传入上一次响应返回的 NextToken
parameters.name: next_token

Data.description_en: The list of notification channel configurations for the current user
Data.description_zh: 当前用户的通知渠道配置列表

Channel.description_en: The notification channel type. Valid values: FEISHU (Lark)
Channel.description_zh: 通知渠道类型。取值：FEISHU（飞书国内版）

additionalProperties.description_en: The value of the configuration item. Sensitive values such as openId, mobile, and email are always displayed as ****** in the actual response
additionalProperties.description_zh: 配置项的取值。openId、mobile、email 等敏感值在实际返回时固定显示为 ******

Config.description_en: The channel configuration information. Both keys and values are strings, which include bound identity information such as openId, mobile, or email. Sensitive values are always displayed as ****** and are not returned in plaintext
Config.description_zh: 渠道配置信息，键和值均为字符串，包含已绑定的身份信息（如 openId、mobile 或 email）。敏感值固定显示为 ******，不返回明文

Enabled.description_en: Indicates whether the notification channel is enabled. If the channel has never been configured, false is returned
Enabled.description_zh: 是否已开启该通知渠道。从未配置过该渠道时返回 false

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时返回的错误码

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the request fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 请求失败时返回的错误信息

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of records per page used for this query
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次查询使用的单页最大记录数

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. This parameter is empty if no more data is available
NextToken.description_zh: 下一页的游标令牌。没有更多数据时为空

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values: true and false
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。取值：true 表示成功，false 表示失败
